task: Trace and reduce concrete-effect work in the W4 deep-inference fixtures using Phase 26 counters.
observation: On baseline 274f848, W4 D18 made 524,451 concrete-effect evaluations for 37 distinct inputs; 524,305 calls ran with the cache disabled, while the effects fixed point completed in one unchanged round. Enabling the existing cache only during the stable authoritative exceptional walk reduced D18 to 201 evaluations and 46,207 parse misses. The same counters fell from 110 to 58 at D5, 2,139 to 113 at D10, and 65,672 to 168 at D15.
impact: The D18 paired median fell from 7,152.46 ms to 28.92 ms (-99.6%); the default 57-fixture median sum fell 56.1%. Full corpus diagnostics and generated-Rust hashes remained unchanged.

resolution.summary: Counters localized the exponential work to cache-disabled nested effect evaluation. The stable phase now memoizes nested concrete-effect summaries while retaining the authoritative outer diagnostic and annotation walk. Local differential, Fast Debug parity, make check, and hosted PR run #30 passed; Architect gave GO for implementation SHA 807d491e8c0e1a1a6701c96d4b5db270705dd837; hosted PR run #30 passed all applicable jobs.
